|Black and white quadpod device constructed out of metal, colored black and white.
 
Has a mounted rifle with red laser to attack enemies.
}}

|{{SkinGallery
|[[File:GraveDiggerRifleSentry.png|200px]]
|Brown and yellow rudimentary armored sentry located in a coffin.

Has a mounted rifle on the sentry to attack enemies.
}}
|Plushie
|{{SkinGallery
|[[File:PlushieRifleSentry.png|200px]]
|Black and white quadpod device constructed out of polyester, colored black and white.

Has a mounted rifle with a yellow screw to attack enemies.
}}
|Phantom
|{{SkinGallery
|[[File:PhantomRifleSentry.png|200px]]
|Black and red quadpod device constructed out of metal, colored black and red.
 
Has two mounted rifle to attack enemies.
}}
|Fallen
|{{SkinGallery
|[[File:FallenRifleSentry.png|200px]]
|Grey orb with a spiked blue tip that has a blue crystal in it.

Blue pedestal that it floats above, with multiple grey spikes and grey top and bottom.
}}
|Dark Frost
|{{SkinGallery
|[[File:DarkFrostRifleSentry.png|200px]]
|FN SCAR rifle with an ammo box and a red laser attached to a small pink vehicle with black tracks and a grey bulldozer blade.

Has purple crystals covering the bulldozer blade.
}}
|Beach
|{{SkinGallery
|[[File:BeachRifleSentry.png|200px]]
|Red and white grill with four metal legs.

Small blue and white box to the left.

Has a water gun inside of it to attack enemies.
}}
|Ghost
|{{SkinGallery
|[[File:GhostRifleSentry.png|200px]]
|Translucent blue ghost with two black eyes and shoulder-pads.

Shoots beams from its hands.
}}
|Springtime
|{{SkinGallery
|[[File:SpringtimeRifleSentry.png|200px]]
|Green crystal floating above a wooden structure that is surrounded by green vines.

Fires beams from the crystal at enemies.
}}
|Bunny
|{{SkinGallery
|[[File:BunnyRifleSentry.png|200px]]
|Brown, orange and grey quadpod device constructed out of metal with many flowers on the sides.
 
Has a mounted rifle with yellow laser to attack enemies.
}}
|Scuba Ops
|{{SkinGallery
|[[File:ScubaOpsRifleSentry.png|200px]]
|Blue and grey underwater drone with two propellers.
 
Has two mounted rifles to attack enemies.
}}
